tagline: Session policy decisions that shape every PDU session
summary: TS 29.512 defines the Session Management Policy Control Service on the PCF. The SMF is the primary consumer: it requests policy for each PDU session and applies QoS, charging, and traffic rules the PCF returns. This spec is the SBI contract for session-level policy — not radio, not registration, not user-plane forwarding.
defines: SM Policy Association lifecycle (create, read, update, delete)
PCC rules, QoS data, charging rules, usage monitoring
PCF-initiated policy update notifications to SMF
whyItMatters: Every PDU session that needs differentiated QoS or charging passes through this service. SMF cannot fully establish or modify a session without policy input from PCF. Fifteen other API specs in the corpus reuse 29.512 schemas — it is a shared policy vocabulary for the core.
